titleEn: Merge BSTs to Create Single BST
title: 合并多棵二叉搜索树
summary: 每棵小 BST 的根可接到另一树同值叶节点，判断能否全部合成一棵合法 BST，成功返回根。
insight: 最终根不能出现在任何叶值中。DFS 最终根并携带合法值区间；遇到叶节点且其值是另一棵树根时立即嫁接，并从待合并根表删除。结束时必须只剩最终根且全树满足严格上下界。
pitfalls: 所有输入树都必须使用
嫁接只能发生在叶节点

solutions.title: 根映射嫁接与区间校验
solutions.idea: 一遍 DFS 同时完成嫁接、BST 校验和使用计数。
steps: 建立 rootValue→root 与所有非根叶值集合，找唯一未出现在叶值中的根
DFS(node,low,high)：越界失败；若叶值对应另一根则嫁接并移除该根
递归左右区间；最终 roots.size==1 才返回根，否则 null

code.java: class Solution { Map<Integer,TreeNode> roots;private boolean validate(TreeNode node,long low,long high){if(node==null)return true;if(node.val<=low||node.val>=high)return false;if(node.left==null&&node.right==null){TreeNode merged=roots.get(node.val);if(merged!=null&&merged!=node){roots.remove(node.val);node.left=merged.left;node.right=merged.right;}}return validate(node.left,low,node.val)&&validate(node.right,node.val,high);}public TreeNode canMerge(List<TreeNode> trees){roots=new HashMap<>();Set<Integer> leaves=new HashSet<>();for(TreeNode tree:trees){roots.put(tree.val,tree);if(tree.left!=null)leaves.add(tree.left.val);if(tree.right!=null)leaves.add(tree.right.val);}TreeNode root=null;for(TreeNode tree:trees)if(!leaves.contains(tree.val)){if(root!=null)return null;root=tree;}if(root==null||!validate(root,Long.MIN_VALUE,Long.MAX_VALUE)||roots.size()!=1)return null;return root;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { private lateinit var roots:MutableMap<Int,TreeNode>;private fun validate(node:TreeNode?,low:Long,high:Long):Boolean{if(node==null)return true;if(node.`val`<=low||node.`val`>=high)return false;if(node.left==null&&node.right==null){val merged=roots[node.`val`];if(merged!=null&&merged!==node){roots.remove(node.`val`);node.left=merged.left;node.right=merged.right}};return validate(node.left,low,node.`val`.toLong())&&validate(node.right,node.`val`.toLong(),high)};fun canMerge(trees:List<TreeNode?>):TreeNode?{roots=HashMap();val leaves=HashSet<Int>();for(treeValue in trees){val tree=treeValue!!;roots[tree.`val`]=tree;tree.left?.let{leaves.add(it.`val`)};tree.right?.let{leaves.add(it.`val`)}};var root:TreeNode?=null;for(treeValue in trees){val tree=treeValue!!;if(tree.`val` !in leaves){if(root!=null)return null;root=tree}};if(root==null||!validate(root,Long.MIN_VALUE,Long.MAX_VALUE)||roots.size!=1)return null;return root} }
code.cpp: class Solution { unordered_map<int,TreeNode*> roots;bool validate(TreeNode* node,long long low,long long high){if(!node)return true;if(node->val<=low||node->val>=high)return false;if(!node->left&&!node->right&&roots.count(node->val)&&roots[node->val]!=node){TreeNode* merged=roots[node->val];roots.erase(node->val);node->left=merged->left;node->right=merged->right;}return validate(node->left,low,node->val)&&validate(node->right,node->val,high);}public: TreeNode* canMerge(vector<TreeNode*>& trees){unordered_set<int> leaves;for(TreeNode* tree:trees){roots[tree->val]=tree;if(tree->left)leaves.insert(tree->left->val);if(tree->right)leaves.insert(tree->right->val);}TreeNode* root=nullptr;for(TreeNode* tree:trees)if(!leaves.count(tree->val)){if(root)return nullptr;root=tree;}if(!root||!validate(root,LLONG_MIN,LLONG_MAX)||roots.size()!=1)return nullptr;return root;} };
